title: Upward Playbook: Sprint Goals & Career Signals — One-to-One Prep
content:
Context:
- Prep for a focused one-to-one with Kyla. Goal: align sprint deliverables with a clear learning stretch for me and surface career signals I should emphasize in my next quarterly calibration.
- Current sprint: finishing the auth-service refactor (spike done, integration stories remaining). Blocker: flaky infra tests and flaky rollout in staging.
- Personal aspiration: move toward tech lead responsibilities (cross-team design, mentoring). Want concrete coaching and sponsorship asks.

Meeting goals (30 min):
1) Quick health check (3–4m): energy, blockers, any urgent risks.
2) Sprint deliverables alignment (8–10m): what success looks like for the auth refactor; de-scope/ship-minimum discussion.
3) Career milestone signals (8–10m): concrete behaviors and evidence to prioritize for next calibration.
4) Action items & sponsorship asks (6–8m): who will help, introductions, concrete commitments.

Signals I want the manager to see (evidence-based):
- Ownership: shipped the integration tests and rolled out to staging with <2 rollback events. Document link: design/eng-9012.
- Cross-team impact: led the API contract sync with Payments and reduced integration issues by X% (proposal: measure via staging incident count).
- Mentorship: ran two pairing sessions and a short doc on debugging patterns for juniors.

Prompts and scripts (what I'll say to get useful feedback):
- "I want to show progress toward tech lead. Which of the three signals below would matter most to you in a calibration conversation?"
- "Here are two trade-offs for the refactor: finish tests now (delay feature) vs ship feature and backfill tests. What would you prefer if we have to compromise?"
- "I could use a sponsor intro to the infra lead for a production test flakiness postmortem. Can you make that intro?"

Risks I will bring up clearly:
- Staging flakiness could delay release; mitigation: freeze merges to auth-service until CI gate revised, run extended smoke tests (Nadia will drive).
- If we de-scope, potential rework cost for Payments team — propose a short contract (2-day buffer) with Payments.

Prep notes I want from Kyla (ask in meeting):
- Quick read of how the org values "ownership" vs "delivery speed" right now — would she favor a slower but cleaner rollout or pushing the feature?
- Suggestions for two concrete examples from last quarter that I can include in my calibration packet.

Outcome metrics to agree on (measureable):
- Integration test suite stability: reduce flaky test count by >=50% in 2 sprints.
- Rollout rollbacks: <=1 rollback in first week of rollout.
- Cross-team incidents related to auth: 0 critical in 4 weeks after release.

Action items (for meeting closure):
- Agree final ship plan and whether to de-scope.
- Confirm sponsor intro for infra postmortem.
- Pick two career examples I will add to calibration packet and set a follow-up to review the draft.

Notes to self (tone & behavior):
- Keep updates short and metric-focused. Avoid diving into implementation details unless asked.
- When asking for sponsorship, be explicit about ask and timeline.
- If manager pushes for speed, offer a compromise: ship behind a feature flag + follow-up remediation plan.
